historical_record.description: The property then held an industrial building.

The City Planning Commission disapproved conditional use to demolish an existing industrial building and construct three dwelling units, final action after the April 11, 2002 approval motion tied 3-3.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and disapproved the project to demolish an existing industrial building and construct three dwelling units, final action after the April 11, 2002 no-DR motion tied 3-3.
The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization to allow the construction of three dwelling units at 1057 Mississippi Street.
The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization to allow the construction of three dwelling units at 1077 Mississippi Street.
